old: Manufacturer product pages illustrate why these roles should remain separate. old: • Discuss Your Masterbatch Application with a known lead Grade or Not sure / Need help. new: • Discuss Your Masterbatch Application even if no Grade has been selected. Share the carrier and receiving resin where known, concentrate and final TiO₂ fractions, preparation and conversion route, expected quantity, destination and evaluation requirements already known. If several Grades are under consideration, list all candidate Grades in the request. Unknown conditions can remain unknown; final suitability depends on technical evaluation in the stated system.
